questions.questionText: int op = 2;  ¿Qué muestra?  switch (op) { case 1: Console.WriteLine("Uno"); break; case 2: Console.WriteLine("Dos"); break; default: Console.WriteLine("Otro"); break; }
questions.questionTextEn: int op = 2;  What does it print?  switch (op) { case 1: Console.WriteLine("Uno"); break; case 2: Console.WriteLine("Dos"); break; default: Console.WriteLine("Otro"); break; }

questions.questionText: char c = 'b';  ¿Qué muestra?  switch (c) { case 'a': Console.Write(1); break; case 'b': Console.Write(2); break; default: Console.Write(0); break; }
questions.questionTextEn: char c = 'b';  What does it print?  switch (c) { case 'a': Console.Write(1); break; case 'b': Console.Write(2); break; default: Console.Write(0); break; }
